resources.string: Pin your favorite books to your Android home screen or reading tablet. Resize freely and tap any book cover to jump straight back to the page where you last left off.
Resume your most recent unfinished book or article at the exact citable paragraph, stable location, or EPUB CFI. Adapts across 5 phone and reading tablet size tiers.

Lets you control this tablet from the Marginalia web view in a browser: taps, swipes, Back and Home, and typing. It works only while you share the screen with the browser (Android asks each time), and only with the web view\'s PIN.
